issues.title: [IT3-05] Build administrator quiz management and validate the web release
issues.body:
As an administrator, I want to publish subject/grade quizzes and review class activity.

Acceptance criteria
- Admin home shows aggregate activity and a quiz editor with all supported question types.
- Administrators can create, edit, and archive quizzes with validation.
- Automated tests cover authorization, grading, persistence, and analytics.
- Browser checks cover login, filters, quiz completion, progress, and mobile layout.
- Documentation and CI support the web app.

Iteration 3 · 8 story points · High priority

issues.title: [IT3-04] Add personal progress analytics and attempt history
issues.body:
As a learner, I want a progress page that shows my actual performance over time and by subject.

Acceptance criteria
- Display accuracy, attempts, study time, activity chart, and subject performance from persisted attempts.
- History links to owned result reviews.
- New users see truthful empty states and attempts are isolated between accounts.

Iteration 3 · 5 story points · High priority

issues.title: [IT3-03] Deliver multiple question types and server-graded quiz attempts
issues.body:
As a learner, I want multiple-choice, true/false, and short-answer questions with a review of my results.

Acceptance criteria
- Ordered quiz runner supports all three types, progress, back/next, and unanswered validation.
- Server grades answers and persists one attempt per submitted run.
- Result review shows explanations and correct answers only after submission.
- Answer keys are omitted from learner quiz responses.

Iteration 3 · 8 story points · High priority

issues.title: [IT3-02] Create learner home and subject/grade quiz discovery
issues.body:
As a learner, I want a clear home page and a searchable quiz library filtered by subject and grades 6–12.

Acceptance criteria
- Responsive dashboard shows recent activity and recommended quizzes.
- Subject, grade, and search filters work together with empty states.
- Accessible navigation works on mobile and desktop.

Iteration 3 · 5 story points · High priority

issues.title: [IT3-01] Build secure web authentication and role-based navigation
issues.body:
As a learner or administrator, I want to sign in to the website and reach the correct home page.

Acceptance criteria
- Registration creates learner accounts with securely hashed passwords.
- Login, logout, session checks, and role-specific navigation work.
- Administrator endpoints reject learner access.
- Requests that change data validate CSRF protection.

Iteration 3 · 5 story points · High priority

issues.title: [SEC-04] Validate local records before loading application data
issues.body:
## Description

Validate local data before constructing domain objects. Reject malformed records with a recoverable error; never interpret them as privileged accounts or valid scores.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Validate schema, required fields, enum values, and domain constraints.
- [ ] Reject malformed account and result records with recovery guidance.
- [ ] Malformed accounts cannot create administrator sessions.
- [ ] Malformed results cannot become valid completed scores.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** SEC-04
- **Priority:** High
- **Estimate:** 5 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 2

## Verification

TC-10, extended with malformed result records in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [SEC-03] Enforce ownership when retrieving learner results
issues.body:
## Description

Derive the history owner from the authenticated session and verify ownership on every own-history request. Do not accept an arbitrary owner ID from console input.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Derive learner identity from the session.
- [ ] Every returned attempt belongs to that learner.
- [ ] Deny internal attempts to access another learner history.
- [ ] Console input cannot select another owner ID.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** SEC-03
- **Priority:** High
- **Estimate:** 3 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 2

## Verification

TC-08 in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [SEC-02] Enforce authorization on every administrator operation
issues.body:
## Description

Check the authenticated role on every administrator operation. Enforce checks in the controller and independently in services so direct internal calls cannot bypass authorization.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Question maintenance, quiz configuration, and aggregate results require an administrator.
- [ ] Deny learner and unauthenticated controller calls.
- [ ] Deny direct unauthorized service calls without changing stored state.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** SEC-02
- **Priority:** High
- **Estimate:** 3 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 1

## Verification

TC-03 and TC-09, including direct service calls in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [SEC-01] Protect stored passwords with salted adaptive hashing
issues.body:
## Description

Use a vetted password-hashing library with an adaptive algorithm such as Argon2id and a unique random salt per account. Never persist plaintext passwords.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Store adaptive hashes with independently generated random salts.
- [ ] Two accounts using the same password have independent salts.
- [ ] Verify passwords through the vetted library.
- [ ] Persisted records contain no plaintext passwords.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** SEC-01
- **Priority:** High
- **Estimate:** 5 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 1

## Verification

TC-02 and two-account salt inspection in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [NFR-04] Support documented C++17 builds on Windows and Linux
issues.body:
## Description

Document C++17 build commands for supported Windows and Linux environments. Isolate platform-specific file handling in the repository adapter.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Record compiler versions, operating systems, and build commands.
- [ ] Compile and run sign-in and quiz smoke tests on Windows and Linux as required by the attached test plan.
- [ ] Confine platform-specific file handling to the repository adapter.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** NFR-04
- **Priority:** Medium
- **Estimate:** 5 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 2

## Verification

TC-12 in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [NFR-03] Provide clear prompts and recoverable input errors
issues.body:
## Description

Show accepted input values at every menu and question prompt. Give a specific correction prompt for invalid choices and continue without crashing.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every menu and question prompt identifies accepted input values.
- [ ] Invalid choices produce a specific correction prompt.
- [ ] The application remains usable and re-prompts after invalid input.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** NFR-03
- **Priority:** Medium
- **Estimate:** 2 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 1

## Verification

TC-06 and prompt review in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [NFR-02] Preserve committed data when file writes fail
issues.body:
## Description

Report file-write failures while retaining a readable last committed data file. Use a temporary file and atomic replacement where supported by the operating system.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Use a temporary file and atomic replacement on supported platforms.
- [ ] An injected write failure leaves the prior committed file readable.
- [ ] Restart recovers the committed state and the failed write is not reported as successful.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** NFR-02
- **Priority:** High
- **Estimate:** 5 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 2

## Verification

TC-10 in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [NFR-01] Meet the local response-time target at the specified data volume
issues.body:
## Description

With up to 1,000 stored questions and 10,000 attempts, complete menu transitions and question loads within 2 seconds for at least 95% of local interactions, excluding user input time.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Seed 1,000 questions and 10,000 attempts on a documented reference machine.
- [ ] Measure at least 20 local menu transitions and question loads.
- [ ] The 95th percentile is at most 2 seconds; record environment and measurements.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** NFR-01
- **Priority:** Medium
- **Estimate:** 5 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 2

## Verification

TC-11 in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [FR-11] Persist accounts, questions, quizzes, and completed attempts
issues.body:
## Description

Save account, question, quiz, and completed-attempt records before confirming successful creation, editing, or submission. Reload saved records after an application restart.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Changes to each record type survive a normal restart.
- [ ] Confirm submission only after the completed attempt is saved.
- [ ] Report failed saves as errors rather than success.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** FR-11
- **Priority:** High
- **Estimate:** 8 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 1

## Verification

TC-01 and TC-04, plus completed-attempt restart checks in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [FR-10] Display the administrator results summary
issues.body:
## Description

Allow authenticated administrators to view completed attempts across learners with username, quiz title, date, and score. Deny this operation to ordinary learners.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Administrators can see completed attempts from multiple learners.
- [ ] Include username, quiz title, date, and score.
- [ ] Deny learner access to this operation.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** FR-10
- **Priority:** Medium
- **Estimate:** 3 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 2

## Verification

TC-09 in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [FR-09] Display the learner's completed result history
issues.body:
## Description

Allow learners to view only their own completed attempts, showing quiz title, date, correct count, total count, and percentage.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Display only completed attempts belonging to the signed-in learner.
- [ ] Include quiz title, date, correct count, total count, and percentage.
- [ ] Exclude all attempts belonging to another learner.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** FR-09
- **Priority:** High
- **Estimate:** 3 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 2

## Verification

TC-08 in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [FR-08] Calculate and display quiz scores
issues.body:
## Description

On submission, count stored answers matching the answer key. Award one point per correct answer with no negative marking. Display the correct count and percentage rounded to one decimal place.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Calculate percentage as 100 × correctCount / totalQuestions, displayed to one decimal place.
- [ ] For key A,C,B and answers A,D,B, display 2/3 and 66.7%.
- [ ] Score a submitted attempt once and produce one completed result.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** FR-08
- **Priority:** High
- **Estimate:** 2 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 2

## Verification

TC-07 in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [FR-07] Recover from invalid quiz answers
issues.body:
## Description

Reject answers outside A, B, C, and D, show a correction message, and re-prompt the same question without recording invalid input.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Entering X shows an error and repeats the current question.
- [ ] Invalid input does not advance the question or record an answer.
- [ ] A subsequent valid answer is recorded once.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** FR-07
- **Priority:** High
- **Estimate:** 1 story point
- **Iteration:** Iteration 1

## Verification

TC-06 in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [FR-06] Implement the quiz attempt flow
issues.body:
## Description

Present each configured question exactly once for the selected quiz, with choices A through D, and record one selected choice per question.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Present every configured question exactly once in configured order.
- [ ] Label choices A through D.
- [ ] Record exactly one valid selected choice per question.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** FR-06
- **Priority:** High
- **Estimate:** 5 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 2

## Verification

TC-05 in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [FR-04] Implement administrator quiz configuration
issues.body:
## Description

Allow authenticated administrators to create and edit quizzes with a nonempty title and at least one active question. Reject references to unknown questions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Save valid quizzes with an ordered set of question IDs.
- [ ] Reject empty titles, no active questions, and unknown question references.
- [ ] Deny unauthorized quiz configuration.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** FR-04
- **Priority:** High
- **Estimate:** 5 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 1

## Verification

TC-03 and TC-04 in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [FR-03] Implement administrator question maintenance
issues.body:
## Description

Allow authenticated administrators to create, edit, and deactivate questions. Require a nonempty prompt, four nonempty choices, and exactly one correct choice.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Administrators can create, edit, and deactivate questions.
- [ ] Reject empty prompts, empty choices, an option count other than four, or an invalid answer key.
- [ ] Unauthorized operations do not change stored data.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** FR-03
- **Priority:** High
- **Estimate:** 5 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 1

## Verification

TC-03 and TC-04 in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [FR-02] Implement authentication and role-specific access
issues.body:
## Description

Authenticate registered usernames and passwords before displaying learner or administrator actions. Display a generic failure message for invalid credentials.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Valid credentials establish a session using the stored role.
- [ ] Actions are available only after authentication.
- [ ] Wrong usernames and passwords produce the same generic failure.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** FR-02
- **Priority:** High
- **Estimate:** 3 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 1

## Verification

TC-02 in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [FR-05] Implement quiz discovery and selection
issues.body:
## Description

Show authenticated learners the available quizzes with each quiz's title, question count, and displayed identifier. Allow selection using that identifier.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Available quizzes display a title, question count, and selectable identifier.
- [ ] A valid identifier starts the selected quiz's attempt flow.
- [ ] Selection is available to authenticated learners.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** FR-05
- **Priority:** High
- **Estimate:** 2 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 1

## Verification

TC-05 in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.

issues.title: [FR-01] Implement learner account registration
issues.body:
## Description

Allow registration with a unique, nonempty username and a password of at least 8 characters. Reject duplicate usernames and invalid inputs.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Valid registration creates one learner account.
- [ ] Empty usernames, passwords shorter than 8 characters, and duplicate usernames are rejected.
- [ ] Confirm success only after the account is saved.

## Planning

- **Requirement:** FR-01
- **Priority:** High
- **Estimate:** 3 story points
- **Iteration:** Iteration 1

## Verification

TC-01 in Part B of the attached Deliverable 1.

**Source:** Attached Deliverable 1, version 1.0, Part A.
